title: BrickFi
tagline: Bricks Fi is a blockchain-based real estate investment platform that helps users grow capital
description:
Bricks Fi is a blockchain-based real estate investment platform that helps users grow capital through property trading while earning steady yield.

We buy and sell real estate over a 60-month cycle, generating appreciation and distributing monthly returns based on portfolio performance.
how_its_made:
BricksRWA is an ERC-4626 tokenized vault written in Solidity, built using Solmate libraries. Depositors receive BRICK shares while their underlying USDC is forwarded to a treasury wallet. The vault has a hard cap, and deposits are paused automatically once the raise is full.

Off-chain yield can be streamed monthly via the addEarnings method, allowing the owner to credit the vault with real-world income.

In short, it’s a lightweight, gas-efficient fundraising vault for real-world asset (RWA) projects—built entirely with open-source Solmate primitives and deployable on any EVM-compatible chain.
